text: A hundred and five minutes. No goal. Then this.
Spain had the ball. Sixty-five per cent of it.
Ninety-third minute. Williams heads, and Martinez says no.
Watch Nico Williams. He doesn't shoot. He heads it across.
To Ferran Torres. Both men came off the bench.
Twelve shots on target. Argentina? None in ninety minutes.
Spain are champions of the world.
